description: A random picker for a list of names, drawn in your browser. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

count.description: How many entries to pick, without repeats. Asking for more than the list holds is an error rather than a shorter answer. Ignored when shuffleAll is true.

items.description: The list to pick from, up to 10000 entries. An entry written twice is deliberately twice as likely to be picked, so duplicates are not collapsed.
One entry to draw from. Duplicates are kept and weight the draw.

shuffleAll.description: Return the whole list in a random order instead of a selection. Every ordering is equally likely, and count is ignored.

name: random_picker
title: Random Picker
